sections.what_happened: [ATTRIBUTED REPORT] Yemen's armed forces said they carried out 1,382 strikes against Ansar Allah, claiming to have 'neutralized' approximately 440 fighters while securing new territorial gains in Taiz. CLAIMANT NUMBERS ONLY: no independent verification, no Ansar Allah response, and no named locations or dates beyond Taiz were carried. Distinct front from the Oct 28 Aden strikes (totw-20261028-1800-02 HELD); do not merge Taiz and Aden tolls.
sections.what_verified: Single carrier, Yeni Safak, NO declared tier in the registry: 0 declared families. Claimant's own toll, uncorroborated.
sections.what_disputed: No independent verification retrieved; no Ansar Allah response carried; no second family carries the 1,382 / 440 figures.
sections.why_matters: Taiz front, army's numbers only: usable inside a Yemen roundup as an attributed claim, never as a confirmed toll or a standalone video.
sections.context: Background: NEW -- Yemen army claims 1,382 strikes 'neutralized' ~440 Ansar Allah fighters, gains in Taiz (claimant-only numbers)

totw_analysis: Our read: Taiz front, army's numbers only: usable inside a Yemen roundup as an attributed claim, never as a confirmed toll or a standalone video. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Whose numbers? The army claims 440 neutralized; no independent count exists.
